scope: Three independent macOS players on loopback. Real consent, input, clock, effort, payments and snapshots. Controlled positioning, wallet depletion and deadline. Not a human or multi-machine acceptance test.

checks: Host opens an actual UDP room
Three independent processes connect
Confirmed arm seats select their camera and input map
Each person takes the nearby seat
Stale consent and premature start never charge either participant
Arrow input changes the visible effort
Mode key selects rhythm
Rules block only local input while shared simulation continues
Capture completes: 01-rules
Returning from rules restores arm controls
Quote exposes normal or doubled resistance cost before consent
Enter confirms the displayed quote without starting the duel
Both participants accept the current revision
Capture completes: 00-confirmation
Start charges opening five once, reserves both stakes and starts a three-second countdown
Spectator waits without a grant or a charge
Leaving keeps participation and the duel clock
Active participant cannot enter a second game after leaving their seat
Participant can return to their ongoing duel
Capture completes: 02-duel
Reduced motion restores the grip scale while the duel continues
Capture completes: 03-reduced-motion
Authoritative duel reaches a paid result with balanced accounting
Twenty real hold/rhythm pulses tie [winner=-1, position=0, pulses=20/20]
Draw returns each stake and records one draw [balances=995/1000, draws=1/1]
Late input cannot duplicate a paid result
Capture completes: 04-result
Capture completes: 05-result-1280x720
Capture completes: 06-result-wide
No runtime errors in host
Peer starts real connection
Arm snapshot arrives over UDP
Exact paid receipt reaches peer
Peer observes the active duel through completion
Peer receives the settled result
